column1: # Settings a receiver's image sets that a provider of records is excused from acting on (docs/firmware/gps.md, "The fields").  A provider's test holds that each setting the images set is one it acts on or one of its rows here, and that no row is for a setting it acts on or one no image sets; it may act on more than the images set.  A row is the project owner's to grant.  The rows are for the providers this repository carries: a provider kept elsewhere keeps a table of its own and gives its text to `Declaration::unacted` and `Declaration::needless`.
